name: M. Burak Dorman
title: Information Systems Engineer
about: A passionate Information Systems Engineer with experience in designing and implementing modern applications, he loves to utilize AI as much as he loves coding. I specialize in building scalable architectures, clean code, and intuitive user interfaces.

My expertise spans back-end development with Java and C#, and I also have experience in full-stack development with React, TypeScript, and Node.js. I enjoy solving complex technical challenges and continuously learning new technologies.
When I'm not coding, you'll find me exploring new technologies, exploring the latest AI developments, or gaming.
